s: Which of the following statements about the Andhra leaders during the Quit India Movement is correct?
o: Pattabhi Sitaramayya, a CWC member, was jailed along with the CWC members.
Unnava Lakshmi Narayana was arrested for the first time only after 1942.
Unnava Lakshmi Narayana led the Communist Conference at Vijayawada in 1943.
Pattabhi Sitaramayya remained underground throughout the movement from Kurnool.
x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya, a member of the Congress Working Committee, was jailed with the other CWC members. Unnava Lakshmi Narayana was jailed again in 1942.
tq: Use the wrong-person-with-role trap by separating Congress, underground and Communist activities.

s: Why did the Communists in Andhra oppose the Quit India Movement in 1942?
